import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix label variant in 'sex' (trim spaces and standardize to lower case)
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].astype(str).str.strip().fillna("unknown").str.lower()
    # Validate and fix 'year' to be integer and within allowed range (2007-2009)
    df["year"] = pd.to_numeric(df["year"], errors='coerce').astype(int)
    df = df[(df["year"] >= 2007) & (df["year"] <= 2009)]
    # Validate numeric columns against rules
    mask = (
        (df["bill_length_mm"] >= 30) & (df["bill_length_mm"] <= 60) &
        (df["bill_length_mm"].notna()) &
        (df["flipper_length_mm"] >= 170) & (df["flipper_length_mm"] <= 235) &
        (df["flipper_length_mm"].notna()) &
        (df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500) &
        (df["body_mass_g"].notna())
    )
    # Also ensure 'species' and 'island' are in allowed sets
    allowed_species = {"Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"}
    allowed_islands = {"Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"}
    mask &= df["species"].isin(allowed_species)
    mask &= df["island"].isin(allowed_islands)
    # Drop rows that do not meet all rules
    df = df[mask]
    # Drop columns not needed for the question (optional, but keeps id and required)
    # We keep all columns except we could drop bill_depth_mm if not needed
    # But per instructions, only fix issues that matter for the question
    # So we keep all columns
    # Ensure 'penguin_id' is preserved
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by 'species' (single column label)
    grouped = df.groupby("species")
    result = {}
    # If only one group, use 'all' key
    if len(grouped) == 1:
        total_mass = grouped.sum().loc[:, "body_mass_g"].sum()
        result["all"] = total_mass
    else:
        for label, group in grouped:
            total_mass = group["body_mass_g"].sum()
            result[label] = total_mass
    # Drop any group with missing total (shouldn't happen unless all NaN)
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if not pd.isna(v)}
    return result
